headline: Apple is reportedly working on iPhone game controllers
summary: Apple is developing two game controllers for the iPhone. The controllers are expected to be sold under the Beats brand. Rumors are supported by macOS code references to first-party hardware.

headline: The Units’ Digital Stimulation is synthpunk perfection
summary: The Units' album "Digital Stimulation" is praised as synthpunk perfection. The band was discovered through the "No Dogs in Space" podcast and synthpunk.org. The review highlights its successful blend of punk rock and synth elements.

headline: Waymo pulls over, calls cops on riders with a ghost gun
summary: A Waymo robotaxi stopped and called police on its passengers in San Francisco. Two juveniles were found with a loaded AR-style 'ghost gun'. The teenagers were arrested and taken to a juvenile hall.

headline: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother will make you forget all about Marvel’s Blade disaster
summary: The film "Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother" is expected to overshadow Marvel's 'Blade' issues. Marvel's handling of its 'Blade' reboot is considered a major studio misstep. Mahershala Ali, attached to 'Blade', stars in this new film.

headline: World of Warcraft: Forever Devs Explain Why the Game Makes WoW 2 Unlikely
summary: World of Warcraft: Forever developers detailed new game features. They clarified why a "WoW 2" sequel is deemed unnecessary. The current game's evolution makes a full sequel improbable.

headline: Scooby-Doo: Origins Reveals Cute New Photo of the Live-Action Dog
summary: "Scooby-Doo: Origins" has released a new promotional photo. The image showcases the cute live-action version of Scooby-Doo. Fans get a fresh look at the iconic animated dog.

headline: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother Review
summary: A review for the film "Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother" has been published. Mahershala Ali stars as a devout, sword-wielding assassin. The movie reunites Ali with his potential 'Blade' director.

headline: StarCraft Devs Promise New Game Will Definitely Release in 2030
summary: StarCraft developers confirmed a new game will be released in 2030. They explained the reasoning behind the distant release date. Potential gameplay elements were also teased during the announcement.

headline: Reform confident it won't need to repay any of £72m under proposed new donor rules
summary: Reform party is confident it won't have to repay £72m under new donor rules. Proposed rule changes affect donations from UK expats. Housing Secretary Angela Rayner stated non-compliance would require money to be returned.

headline: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
summary: Russia attacked a Ukrainian train station shortly after Boris Johnson and European officials departed. The former UK PM condemned the strike on a stationary locomotive. Johnson questioned Putin's motive for targeting the train near the Polish border.

headline: Trump downplays warnings of AI risks as he cites rivalry with China
summary: Donald Trump downplayed warnings regarding the risks of Artificial Intelligence. He attributed concerns to "negative forces" aiming to impede progress. Trump linked the discussion to the ongoing rivalry between the US and China.

headline: Andy Burnham among Great North Run finishers
summary: Andy Burnham successfully completed this year's Great North Run. The popular half marathon event saw 63,000 participants. The Prime Minister was also among the finishers.
